newsitem.title: UK: Cortecs to form parent company, list in UK.
newsitem.headline: Cortecs to form parent company, list in UK.

text.p: UK-based pharmaceuticals company Cortecs International Ltd said on Friday it had decided to form a new company, Cortecs Plc, to act as its parent company, with its primary listing on the London Stock Exchange.

Cortecs said since CIL shares were listed in London in 1994, the majority of new capital raised had been in the UK and other European countries, with most of the trading in its shares occurring in London rather than on the Australian Stock Exchange.
Although its primary listing has been in Australia, most of Cortecs' business and the vast majority of its employees are in the UK.
Cortecs said as a result, "it is now appropriate for the group to have as its parent company an English public company with a primary listing on the London Stock Exchange."
Cortecs said existing shareholders in CIL would effectively exchange their shares shares in Cortecs Plc.
Dealings in Cortecs Plc are likely to start towards the end of September. The shares will also be traded on the Australian Stock Exchange and Nasdaq.
